meta.description: A three-unit residential investment opportunity in Old Town Newhall, California.

expenses.basis: Broker estimate; responsibility to be verified

expenses.basis: Broker estimate; responsibility to be verified

sale_comps.note: Renovated multi-building property with newer ADU and pool; materially superior condition.
Larger triplex with stable tenancy; normalized yield shown on the same residential basis.
Pride-of-ownership triplex with stable tenants and lower in-place rents.
Three detached homes on a larger lot; deeply suppressed rents make reported yield non-comparable.

rent_evidence.note: Selected near the lower quartile for the detached rear house; condition and lease terms require verification.
Selected below the lower quartile to reflect vintage and current condition.
Achieved rents of $2,175 to $3,450 support the direction of the pro forma but reflect superior condition.
